question: Should Peekaboo’s README permanently display and link to a live ranking badge from MCP Toplist?
rationale: The implementation is only a README addition, but accepting a continuously updated third-party ranking badge is a project-presentation and endorsement decision that source inspection cannot resolve.

options.title: Decline the external ranking badge
options.body: Keep the existing README presentation focused on project-controlled and established distribution badges.

options.title: Accept after ownership verification
options.body: Merge only after confirming the linked listing is the intended project record and that maintainers accept the ongoing third-party branding and availability dependency.

recommendation.title: Decline the external ranking badge
recommendation.body: Keep the existing README presentation focused on project-controlled and established distribution badges.

likelyOwner.reason: The available release and project-history signals make this the best available owner for a public README endorsement decision.
